entities.name: Location Measurement Indication
entities.description: Procedure where the UE indicates to the network that it is going to start or stop location-related measurements towards E-UTRA or NR that require measurement gaps, or start/stop detection of subframe and slot timing towards E-UTRA that requires measurement gaps.

entities.name: AS security activation successful
entities.description: Condition that the UE shall have successfully activated AS security before initiating the Location Measurement Indication procedure.

entities.name: Measurement gap configuration
entities.description: Property indicating that the configuration of measurement gaps is a network decision.

entities.name: eutra-RSTD
entities.description: Location measurement towards E-UTRA for Reference Signal Time Difference.

entities.name: nr-RSTD
entities.description: Location measurement towards NR for Reference Signal Time Difference.

entities.name: nr-UE-RxTxTimeDiff
entities.description: Location measurement towards NR for UE Rx-Tx time difference.

entities.name: nr-PRS-RSRP
entities.description: Location measurement towards NR for Positioning Reference Signal Reference Signal Received Power.

entities.name: eutra-FineTimingDetection
entities.description: Detection of subframe and slot timing towards E-UTRA.

relations.description: The Location Measurement Indication procedure requires that AS security is successfully activated before initiation.
The procedure may involve indicating start/stop of eutra-RSTD measurements.
The procedure may involve indicating start/stop of nr-RSTD measurements.
The procedure may involve indicating start/stop of nr-UE-RxTxTimeDiff measurements.
The procedure may involve indicating start/stop of nr-PRS-RSRP measurements.
The procedure may involve indicating start/stop of eutra-FineTimingDetection.
The network decision to configure measurement gaps guards the execution of the Location Measurement Indication procedure.
